task_grounding:
Open /home/user/Documents/gear.obj in CloudCompare. It is an OBJ mesh with exactly 48 vertices and 80 triangular faces. Produce two output files:
1. A PLY mesh at /home/user/Documents/gear.ply preserving all 48 vertices and all 80 triangular faces (export the mesh, not the vertices-only cloud).
2. An ASCII XYZ point cloud at /home/user/Documents/gear.xyz containing only the 48 mesh vertices, with no color or extra columns (just X Y Z). Use File > Save As on the mesh for the first output, and then extract the vertices (e.g., right-click 'Mesh > Sample points' is NOT what we want — instead use 'Edit > Mesh > Sample Points on a Mesh' only if it is exact; simpler: in the DB Tree right-click the mesh's 'Vertices' sub-item and save it as an ASCII cloud).

verification.description: XYZ is detected as ASCII cloud

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
